blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The government has provided financial and livelihood assistance to Mary Jane Veloso and her family after President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. granted her an absolute pardon, according to Malacañang. In a briefing on Monday, Palace press officer Claire Castro said personnel from the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) field office in Central Luzon visited Veloso and her family in the municipality of Gen. Mamerto Natividad, Nueva Ecija, to provide P50,000 in cash relief assistance and assess the family’s livelihood needs following her release.
